single.rationale: Tenable demonstrates strong fundamentals with accelerating free cash flow ($255M at 25.5% margin), near operating breakeven despite heavy R&D investment (22.4% of revenue), and steady 11% revenue growth reaching $999M. The exposure management category appears strategically positioned for the evolving cybersecurity landscape (AI, cloud, identity threats), though intensifying competition and shift to annual billing from multi-year upfront contracts warrant closer examination of competitive positioning and cash dynamics.
